guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: recommendationservice is the only service with resource-level anomalies besides latency (mem +163%, socket 4 -> 18.9), and frontend warnings read 'failed to get product recommendations'. productcatalogservice latency-90 is the top z-score, but recommendationservice calls it and the frontend and currencyservice also call it, so that spike more likely reflects shared symptoms than a distinct origin; the digest cannot cleanly separate mem from socket.

proposed_fix.description: Restart or roll the recommendationservice pods, and inspect for a memory leak and connection buildup. Raise memory limits temporarily if needed, then verify productcatalogservice latency recovers.
